entries.title: SSX Blur

emulation.notes: Use real Wii controls where possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-resolution Wii emulation with original controls

primary.why: Blur is a Wii-only entry built around Wii Remote and Nunchuk controls, adding slalom and motion-drawn Ubertricks while recycling/reworking earlier SSX content.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii hardware for the intended controls, or Dolphin with Wii Remote support if you want higher output resolution.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Dolphin can raise image quality, but real Wii controls best preserve the motion-control design.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster documented; much content is reworked from earlier games but the controls are unique to Wii.
